scripts.check:circular-kernel: madge --circular --extensions ts --ts-config tsconfig.app.json src/kernel/ 2>&1 | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{console.log(d);if(/Found \\d+ circular/.test(d))process.exit(1)})"
